exec docker build -qt fail-updater .

! dependabot update go_modules dependabot/cli --updater-image fail-updater
stderr 'updater failure: updater exited with code 2'

# Assert that the test command doesn't fail if the updater fails
dependabot test -f input.yml --updater-image fail-updater

exec docker rmi -f fail-updater

-- Dockerfile --
FROM ubuntu:24.04

RUN useradd -m dependabot && \
    mkdir -p /home/dependabot && \
    chown dependabot:dependabot /home/dependabot

COPY --chown=dependabot:dependabot --chmod=755 update-ca-certificates /usr/bin/update-ca-certificates
COPY --chown=dependabot:dependabot --chmod=755 run bin/run

USER dependabot
WORKDIR /home/dependabot

-- update-ca-certificates --
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
echo "Updating CA certificates..."

-- run --
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
echo "simulating updater crash with code 2" >&2
exit 2

-- input.yml --
input:
  job:
    package-manager: go_modules
    source:
      provider: github
      repo: dependabot/cli
      directory: /
output:
    - type: mark_as_processed
